name: FSL Top-up & Eddy Correct & QC  (CUDA/GPU)
summary: Corrects DWI for susceptibility distortions, eddy currents and motion with FSL topup and eddy (GPU eddy_cuda), using a reverse phase-encoded DWI or AP/PA field maps, and outputs the corrected DWI, a brain mask, eddy QC and motion regressors.
description: Estimates the susceptibility field with FSL topup from b0 volumes of opposite phase-encoding (from the reverse-encoded DWI or from AP/PA EPI field maps), then corrects motion, eddy currents and distortions with eddy (eddy_cuda on GPU by default) and runs eddy_quad QC. Outputs the corrected DWI with rotated b-vectors, a brain mask, eddy QC and motion regressors. Phase-encoding direction and readout time (param) must be set correctly. Optional features: outlier replacement (repol), slice-to-volume correction (mporder with slspec), merging both phase-encodings (mergefull), reslicing the reverse DWI (needs a FreeSurfer license) and b-value shell harmonisation.

inputs.description: The path to the DWI datatype
Reverse encoded dwi image needed to run top-up
Optional field map; the AP/PA EPI images (epi1/epi2 with JSON sidecars) are used for topup instead of the reverse-encoded DWI.
inputs.requirements: epi1_json and epi2_json must contain PhaseEncodingDirection and TotalReadoutTime.

outputs.description: Final corrected diffusion data after TOPUP + EDDY.
Brain mask derived from the corrected mean b0 image.
Archived intermediate files produced during preprocessing. This directory ensures reproducibility and debugging capability.
Quality control outputs generated by FSL eddy_quad.
Tabular motion and distortion parameters for downstream modeling.

parameters.description:
Phase encoding direction of the diff (not rdiff), i.e. first, inputted dwi.

for example, if the phase encoding direction of the first inputted dwi is 'PA', then select 'PA'. If it was 'AP', then select 'AP'

options.label: posterior-->anterior
options.description: Phase encoding direction of first input was done in posterior/anterior direction

options.label: anterior-->posterior
options.description: Phase encoding direction of first input was done in anterior/posterior

options.label: left-->right
options.description: Phase encoding direction of first input was done in left/right

options.label: right-->left
options.description: Phase encoding direction of first input was done in right/left

parameters.description:
This is the 'dwell time'. Please see https://fsl.fmrib.ox.ac.uk/fsl/fslwiki/eddy/Faq#How_do_I_know_what_to_put_into_my_--acqp_file for more information about this specific parameter.
If not set, the app will try to estimate this value from the metadata.
topup: (approximate) resolution (in mm) of warp basis for the different sub-sampling levels
topup: sub-sampling scheme
topup: FWHM (in mm) of gaussian smoothing kernel
topup: number of iterations
topup: Weight of regularisation
topup: If set (=1), lambda is weighted by current ssq
topup: Model for regularisation of warp-field
topup: Estimate movements if set
topup: Minimisation method 0=Levenberg-Marquardt, 1=Scaled Conjugate Gradient
topup: Order of spline, 2->Qadratic spline, 3->Cubic spline
topup: Precision for representing Hessian, double or float
topup: Image interpolation model, linear or spline
topup: If set (=1), the images are individually scaled to a common mean
topup: If set (=1), the calculations are done in a different grid
Eddy-correct: reference volume to align everything to
If true, the reverse phase-encoded DWI (rdif) is merged with the main DWI as input to eddy, not only used for topup.
If, for whatever reason, the two DWI images do not have the same number of slices, set reslice to true and it will reslice the rdif image to diff
If enabled, the application performs skull stripping on the DWI data to generate a brain mask for use during the top-up step.

If set to true, the pipeline will use eddy_cuda instead of eddy_openmp to perform motion and eddy-current correction.
eddy_cuda enables GPU acceleration of the EDDY step and can substantially reduce processing time on compatible systems.

Set to true only if the diffusion acquisition is approximately multi-shell or single-shell, as expected by FSL eddy --data_is_shelled. Leave as false for non-shelled acquisitions (for example DSI or other irregular q-space sampling), since forcing this option on unsuitable data can cause eddy to fail.
Intended number of eddy iterations; not read by topup_eddy.sh in this version.
Order of the slice-to-volume motion model passed to eddy --mporder; 0 disables it. Values above 0 need slspec.
Slice acquisition order for slice-to-volume correction, given as whitespace-separated slice indices that are reshaped into rows of three and passed to eddy --slspec.
If true, eddy detects and replaces outlier slices (--repol).
If true, b-values are snapped to the nearest value in shell_targets before processing.
Comma-separated target b-values used when harmonize_shells is true.
Maximum allowed distance between a b-value and its target shell when harmonising; larger differences cause an error.

failure_modes.message: ERROR: mporder > 0 but slspec is missing
failure_modes.fix: Provide slspec or set mporder to 0.

failure_modes.message: ERROR: harmonize_shells=true but shell_targets is empty
ERROR: param must be numeric TotalReadoutTime in seconds
failure_modes.fix: Set param to the total readout time in seconds.
